scope: Consolidation of retained public metadata sorting declarations, saved synthetic-source coverage and acceptance gaps; no new application source evaluation or workload
sourceDecision: Retain production unchanged. The selected retained reviews establish declarations and saved assertion source, but no supported compatible public sorting defect. The missing evidence is a source-bound finite qualification of the real MetadataTable/SortHeader/useSort/comparator composition; the saved metadata presentation harnesses replace that composition. Helper assertion source and historical synthetic presentation results cannot fill that gap. Specify the minimal qualification and its isolation/authority before any separately authorized execution. Do not repeat individual comparator/parser/icon/header reviews or manufacture an implementation change.
